assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has sick sinus syndrome
The patient had a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
Diagnosis codes I48.91 and I49.5 support the clinical presentation
Continuous mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary
The payer's denial code CO-197 reflects the missing precertification
This appeal seeks to reverse the denial based on documented clinical indications
